title: Lal Bahadur Shastri's birth chart
metaDescription: Lal Bahadur Shastri's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 8.6° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, the Sun holds a square to Neptune at 0.5° — close enough to weld identity to imagination. A square is the tradition’s engine room: two drives at cross purposes, and the friction is the horsepower.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 8.6° into Libra — the first decan, which the old scheme hands to Venus. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 20.8° Virgo, Venus was at 1.7° Scorpio, Mars was at 0.4° Virgo. Read together: thought with its feet on the ground; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun and Neptune hold the closest angle here — a square, 0.5° wide. A square is the tradition’s engine room: two drives at cross purposes, and the friction is the horsepower. Behind it, Mercury square Pluto at 0.9°, and Jupiter trine Uranus at 1.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Mars, Jupiter, Uranus close a triangle of trines. A grand trine is read as self-sufficiency in one element: the current circulates whether or not anything is asked of it. Uranus opposes Pluto while both square Mercury. The t-square is the figure the old texts trusted for output: friction with a fixed address.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks four placements here. The Sun in Libra at 8.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mercury in Virgo at 20.8° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Scorpio at 1.7° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Aquarius at 14.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 3, earth 2, water 2, fire 2; modalities mutable 4, cardinal 3, fixed 2. Jupiter, Saturn and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Gemini into Cancer during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.4° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
